messages:
maria: CI red on PR #5234 — docker push failing after Dockerfile base-image bump. Pasting last few lines:

maria: ```
Step 12/14 : COPY --from=builder /app/dist /app
 ---> Using cache
Successfully built 8a3f2b
Successfully tagged registry.redwood.ai/infra/builder:pr-5234
The push refers to repository [registry.redwood.ai/infra/builder]
1.2.3: preparing
unauthorized: authentication required
``` 

ci-bot: Job infra-build-pr-5234 failed on runner r-12 (ubuntu-20.04). push step exit code 1. full log: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/5234

kevin: hmm I merged a base-image update earlier today (alpine->debian-slim). doubts it's related to auth but worth checking secrets. Did CI rotate the registry token?

alex: @maria can you try re-running the pipeline once? CI service account tokens expire when rotated.

jia: I rotated the infra-push token yesterday to fix flaky pushes and updated k8s secret 'registry/infra-push', but forgot to restart runners. I'll restart the runner pool now.

sam: also sometimes the cache yields a manifest mismatch; try building with no cache and using buildx push: e.g.

sam: ```bash
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 -t registry.redwood.ai/infra/builder:pr-5234 --push --no-cache .
# or force login on runner
echo "$REGISTRY_TOKEN" | docker login registry.redwood.ai -u gitlab-ci-token --password-stdin
```

maria: re-run started (job 5234-retry-1)

ci-bot: Retry job started by maria

maria: new error after retry:

maria: ```
The push refers to repository [registry.redwood.ai/infra/builder]
1.2.3: preparing
failed to copy: httpReadSeeker: failed open: unexpected EOF
``` 

kevin: unexpected EOF usually points to network or registry S3 backend hiccup. Try buildx with --no-cache + --push and/or docker buildx prune on runner. Also consider splitting build and push (store image in registry via temporary tag then push).

sam: commands to clear on runner:

sam: ```bash
docker buildx prune --all --force
docker system prune -a --volumes --force
# then rebuild
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 -t registry.redwood.ai/infra/builder:pr-5234 --push --no-cache .
```

maria: did buildx prune and a runner restart, re-running (job 5234-retry-2)

ci-bot: Job 5234-retry-2 completed: push succeeded

maria: green ✅ pushed with tag pr-5234. Thanks @jia for restart and @sam for the prune commands :tada:

kevin: nice. Follow-ups: add a post-rotate hook to restart runner pool and add retry+backoff to push step in CI.

maria: filing a quick ticket now — will add the CI retry and a note in runbook. Closing the thread.
